findings.summary: Specification content changed materially in round 2 but revision counters stayed at 1; addressed by raising specification.json revision and manifest specification.revision to 2 in sync with planRevision.
Focus-restore frame callback should guard against a viewer closed inside the frame; addressed by a one-line guard requirement in plan step 4.

requirementFit.summary: All three operator asks are covered and traceable: REQ-STORIES-VIEW (fullscreen overlay, 5000 ms auto-close via a page-owned timer, backdrop/Escape manual close, CSS progress bar), REQ-STORIES-ADD (hidden accept=image/* input opened at click time, prepend right after the add tile with the unread ring, no auto-open, input value reset), REQ-STORIES-READ (gradient ring vs muted _viewed modifier, page-props state, reset on reload).

implementationQuality.summary: Round-1 MAJOR findings closed with mechanisms verified against the actual Block semantics: hbs-embedded children re-instantiate on parent re-render without destroy or fresh CDM, so the page owns the timer (cleared before re-arm, on close, in destroy override), re-focuses the overlay in CDU, and wires the file input through a delegated change events prop (refs only exist for component helpers, CDM listeners die on first re-render). No false-green tests remain: Escape is tested after focus including post-re-render, auto-close is tested at the timer owner, and the viewer holds no timers.

evidenceQuality.summary: EV-ST-1 maps every criterion to deterministic gates (npm run verify with sinon fake timers and DOM-order assertions, guard strict); jsdom-unprovable claims (progress bar span, fullscreen look at 375/768/1280, ring fade) are explicitly a manual checklist for the task result, not gate claims.

residualRisk.summary: No backend, store, controller or main.ts changes; object URLs stay in memory by design (SEC-LOCAL-STATE); the stacked base on unmerged feature/2026-10-19-chats-social is documented with a rebase-to-dev contingency and a no-PR-before-merge rule; write-set is 13 exact files disjoint from protected authority.

rounds.summary: Three MAJOR (Escape focus path, raw-HTML ref / CDM change-listener wiring, viewer-owned zombie timer), two MINOR (unprovable acceptance claims, stacked base contingency), one NIT (viewer mount point, story id source).
Both remaining findings are NIT-level (specification revision counters, rAF focus guard) and were addressed before freeze; no MAJOR or blocking findings.

Controller revision after round 2: acceptance-criteria.md reformatted to the verifier's machine-readable AC table (content unchanged, details preserved below the table) and revision counters synced; READY_TO_FREEZE carried over from the round-2 independent review of the same substance.
